message.content: Here are five fun true or false questions to introduce a new teacher. One: Our teacher 先生 can juggle oranges. Two: They have a pet turtle. Three: They love pizza. Four: They teach 日本語 sometimes. Five: They wear socks with sandals. Ask your new teacher for the real answers. Hello, こんにちは
